reason: Acceptance criteria and Definition of Done for the P4 broker foundation slice.
Checklist for current credential paths, control order, seam candidates, affected tests, and risks to preserve.
Checklist for keeping the provider seam local-only, no-migration, no-deployment-change, and future-compatible.
Security regression checklist for SSH scope, credential audit metadata, grant-before-resolution behavior, and fail-closed enforcement.
Check GORM hooks/encrypted fields are preserved and no migrations/schema drift are introduced.
Check new code/tests do not log or persist decrypted secrets, executor config, command/output, endpoints, or host-sensitive values.
Check no external provider runtime, env var, compose, or deployment documentation changes are introduced.
